regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kninly generous favor receive and noted yesterday. I am glad to know that you are well and that the outlook is bright for your Daughter Adelaide. I hope she may have best success June 5th is most important and - , seccess that day or no srecess - that she strive by every means that our holy Mother the Church offers us, to keep close and dear to the Holy Family, Jesus, Mary and Joseph. I was rather disapointed, as I quite surmised it reght along, that yourself and Mr. O'Donnell failed to understand eachother. However, as you write I hope it was best that you parted. One thing about it I am more than pleased with, viz, that you both seem decidedly charitable toward oneanother. I do hope to know that you keep up that really edifying and friendly feeling. All this even with a touch of "ire" on either side. I am glad too that while it was quite out of the question for him to leave Chicago the last several weeks you were with him, his Wife Winifred was able to go down and prepare things for the meeting and procuring of a new care-taker. He followed for a "week-end" absence and they seem quite satisfied that they struckin with a quite desirable successor. How wonderful the ways of the good God when we foster confidence in Him by just leaving at least somthing that seems important for Him to take care of! Blessed be His Holy Name.

regions.merged_text: My Dear Mr. Costello: God bless you and yours.
regions.full_page: My Dear Mr. Costello: God bless you and yours.
regions.per_polygon: My Dear Mr. Costello: God bless you and yours.

regions.merged_text: Assuring you that I feel it a privilege to have made your acquaintenance even without having actually met you and praying the good God to guide you and all your friends, I beg to remain Sincerely Yours in Christ,
